server_url.label: ArchiveTune Server URL
server_url.description: Address of your ArchiveTune Server, reachable from Music Assistant, for example http://192.168.1.50:8780.

token.label: Token
token.description: Value of ARCHIVETUNE_TOKEN on the server. Leave empty if the server runs without a token.
